$schema_note: Machine-readable baseline of every version-dependent claim the cost-control bundle relies on. The cost-control-verify skill diffs the CURRENT Claude Code version's docs against this file, writes CHANGELOG entries, and patches the 'affects' targets. verdict/confidence are as-of baseline_verified_date. Edit via the skill, not by hand, so the changelog stays honest.
baseline_docs_version: unpinned (docs fetched 2026-07-16; pin the exact version with `claude --version` on first install)

claims.summary: Which hook surface can block a subagent spawn.
claims.current_value: A subagent spawn IS a PreToolUse tool call on the `Agent` tool (renamed from `Task` in v2.1.63; `Task(...)` references still work as aliases — sub-agents.md). PreToolUse blocks via JSON permissionDecision:'deny' and is the ONLY hook surface that can block a spawn. `SubagentStart` fires when a subagent is spawned but CANNOT block (hooks.md exit-code table: 'Shows stderr to user only'; decision-control: context-injection only) — its payload carries agent_id/agent_type, no model. `TaskCreated` is the task-LIST event ('when a task is being created via TaskCreate' — hooks.md) and is unrelated to spawns; blocking it rolls back a todo item.
claims.verify: doc-fetch hooks.md exit-code table + sub-agents.md rename note; live: spawn fable subagent, expect deny entry in model-guard.jsonl

affects.what: PreToolUse-only blocking; SubagentStart observe-only; TaskCreated passthrough
guards on PreToolUse Agent|Task; SubagentStart/Stop logging only; NO TaskCreated registration

claims.summary: Field layout of the Agent tool's tool_input as seen by PreToolUse hooks.
claims.current_value: The hooks reference does not publish a per-tool tool_input table for Agent. Strong indirect evidence: the Agent SDK docs show tool_use blocks named Agent with `input.subagent_type`, and sub-agents.md confirms a per-invocation `model` parameter exists (model resolution order step 2). The guards probe .tool_input.model / .tool_input.params.model / .tool_input.opts.model and fail open.
claims.verify: claude --debug: dump hook stdin on a spawn; inspect field paths. LOAD-BEARING under defaults: wrong paths => model='' => allow. Backstops: CC_REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_MODEL=1 and/or the availableModels managed gate.

claims.summary: Subagent frontmatter supports a `hooks:` key scoped to that agent's lifecycle.
claims.current_value: sub-agents.md 'Supported frontmatter fields' lists `hooks` ('Lifecycle hooks scoped to this subagent'); 'Define hooks for subagents' documents PreToolUse-in-frontmatter firing while the agent is active, including when spawned via the Agent tool. CAVEAT: plugin-shipped subagents IGNORE frontmatter hooks/mcpServers/permissionMode — the bundle's agents must live in ~/.claude/agents/ or .claude/agents/ (they do).

claims.summary: Do settings.json PreToolUse hooks fire for tool calls made BY a subagent?
claims.current_value: AMBIGUOUS in current docs. hooks.md common-input fields say agent_id is 'present only when the hook fires inside a subagent call' (implying some hooks fire inside subagents), while sub-agents.md positions frontmatter hooks as the way to run hooks 'only while that subagent is active' and settings.json for main-session lifecycle events. Nested subagent spawns exist as of v2.1.172 (depth ≤5). The frontmatter-replicated gate covers nested spawns REGARDLESS of which reading is right, so this claim is not load-bearing.
claims.verify: claude --debug: run a subagent that calls Bash; check whether the settings-level PreToolUse hook logged with agent_id set

affects.what: gate replicated into frontmatter (harmless belt-and-suspenders if settings hooks do fire inside subagents)

claims.summary: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL is a highest-precedence override; =inherit == unset.
claims.current_value: model-config.md env-var table: 'Overrides the per-invocation model parameter and the subagent definition's model frontmatter. Set to inherit to use normal model resolution.' sub-agents.md gives the full resolution order: (1) CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, (2) per-invocation model param, (3) frontmatter, (4) main conversation's model. inherit==unset as of v2.1.196 (earlier versions: inherit forced the main model).

affects.what: comment telling user not to set it globally
env override mirrored in model resolution

claims.summary: Built-in Explore agent's default model (research said it stopped forcing Haiku ~2.1.198).
claims.current_value: Built-in subagents Explore/Plan/general-purpose exist (hooks.md matcher examples name them). Their default models are not stated in the docs fetched. Our custom Explore with model:haiku overrides the built-in for that name and is valid regardless.

affects.what: custom haiku override; harmless if built-in differs

claims.summary: Statusline stdin JSON carries live rate_limits + cost + context fields.
claims.current_value: statusline.md 'Available data' documents rate_limits.{five_hour,seven_day}.used_percentage (0-100) + .resets_at (unix epoch seconds); cost.total_cost_usd; context_window.used_percentage; exceeds_200k_tokens; effort.level; output_style.name; agent.name. rate_limits appears only for Claude.ai subscribers (Pro/Max) AFTER the first API response; each window may be independently absent — docs recommend the `// empty` jq guard the scripts use. ANSI colors are supported; Claude Code CAPTURES the script's stdout (never a tty), so never gate colors on isatty.
claims.verify: doc-fetch statusline.md; or write hook/statusline stdin to a file mid-session

affects.what: reads these fields; colors gated on CC_STATUSLINE_NOCOLOR only
reads state file derived from them

claims.summary: Dynamic workflow size options + runtime caps + large-workflow warning.
claims.current_value: Sizes CONFIRMED: unrestricted / small(<5) / medium(<15) / large(<50). Runtime caps CONFIRMED: 16 concurrent, 1000 total. The '1.5M projected tokens / 25 agents' Large-workflow warning is NOT in docs (likely internal heuristic) — UNVERIFIED.

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1; CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA=1. Metrics claude_code.token.usage / .cost.usage / .session.count. BONUS: per-subagent attribution via attributes agent.name and query_source ('subagent' vs 'main').

affects.what: can add agent.name / query_source breakdown panels
subagent drill-down available via metric attrs, not only traces

claims.summary: availableModels hard gate + managed-settings paths + enforcement scope.
claims.current_value: model-config.md 'Restrict model selection': the allowlist applies to the main session model (/model, --model, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, resume), alias resolution, AND subagent models — 'the model field in subagent frontmatter, the Agent tool's model parameter, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL'. Entries match a family alias (sonnet), a version prefix, or a full model ID. An excluded subagent value is SKIPPED and the subagent runs on the inherited model. enforceAvailableModels (v2.1.175+) extends it to the Default picker option. Managed paths (settings.md): macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/, Linux/WSL /etc/claude-code/, Windows C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\; managed-settings.d/*.json drop-ins merge alphabetically. Managed settings parse TOLERANTLY (invalid entries stripped with a warning; /doctor lists them); user/project/local files are STRICT (invalid file rejected as a whole). settings.md lists availableModels as settable in any scope, though model-config frames it as managed/policy — a user-scope allowlist is self-serve but also self-removable.

claims.summary: Background-session / agent-view control surface + claude agents --json schema.
claims.current_value: agent-view.md CLI table: claude agents / --cwd / --json (+--all), claude attach/logs/stop/respawn/rm, claude daemon status/stop. --json entries: cwd, kind, startedAt (camelCase); background entries add id and state ∈ working|blocked|done|failed|stopped; pid/status only while the process is alive (+waitingFor when status=waiting). `claude stop <id>` (alias kill). disableAgentView setting + CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW env. STILL UNVERIFIED: CLAUDE_DISABLE_ADOPT, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS (the latter is referenced by sub-agents.md fork-mode notes, so likely real).
claims.verify: doc-fetch agent-view.md; run `claude agents --json | jq` and eyeball the fields

affects.what: sorts by startedAt; filters state=working; stops via claude stop

claims.current_value: ~/.claude/output-styles/NAME.md (user) or .claude/output-styles/NAME.md (project). Frontmatter: name, description, keep-coding-instructions, force-for-plugin. Activate via /config or settings outputStyle.

claims.summary: UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart can inject additionalContext.
claims.current_value: Both support hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (or plain stdout). SessionStart is non-blocking; UserPromptSubmit injects alongside the prompt. SubagentStart also supports additionalContext (injected into the subagent's context) — available for a future per-subagent nudge.
/usage attributes recent usage to skills, subagents, plugins, individual MCP servers, each as % of total; 24h/7d toggle. Requires v2.1.174+.

claims.summary: How to read the installed Claude Code version.
claims.current_value: `claude --version` (or `-v`) prints a string containing the semver; no public `version` field guaranteed in session/statusline data (app.version available via telemetry OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_VERSION).
